1News file - (Auguest 26, 2019)
  
               Welcome to MSC Nastran 2019 Feature Pack 1 (2019 FP1)
  
  
   MSC Nastran brings powerful new features and enhancements for engineering
   solutions.
  
     MSC Nastran 2019 FP1 Features and Enhancements
  
     Dynamics
     - Real Coupled Modes can now be computed in Normal Modes (SOL 103) and
       available for modal reduction in frequency (SOL 111) and transient
       response (SOL 112) solution sequences. Structural, Fluid and
       Combined Modes are printed to F06 file and output to HDF5 and OP2
       result files.
     - Hydrostatic loading of fluids.
     - Improved performance of large Body-in-White models with poroelastic
       materials (PEM).
     - Modeling of PEM materials with 2D elements.
     - Airgap modeling between PEM materials and structure.
     - Elastic Forces can be requested in Frequency and Transient Response
       Solutions (SOLs 108,111,109,112,200,400),and Flutter Solution
       (SOL 146) for user specified grid points.
     - Monitor Points results are written to ADAMSMNF file.
     - Composites ply results for random response are printed to F06 files and
       output to HDF5 and OP2 results files.
     - Hashin Failure Criteria and Strengh Ratio introduced for layered
       composite shell elements in linear solution sequences.
  
     SOL 400 Implicit Nonlinear Analysis
     - Segment to Segment method available for linear contact (LINCNT)
     - Allow users to request a linear buckling analysis following a perturbed
       nonlinear analysis in SOL 400
     - Support Surface Contact capability. Surface definition provides clear
       description for potential contact area and enable to avoid unnecessary &
       unclear model definition and yield accurate contact results
  
     High Performance Computing (HPC)
     - Residual vector calculation for fluids and augmentation of fluid
       eigenvectors (in SOL 103, SOL 111, SOL 200) for improved accuracy in
       models with significant acoustic sources.
     - Reduced memory requirements for ACMS, especially in high frequency
       analysis.
     - Massless mechanism identification and control (PARAM MECHFIX)
       available for ACMS
     - Automatic memory adaptivity in DMP mode, improving performance of slave
       processes (SOL 111, SOL 200).
     - GPU Acceleration for FASTFR and MPYAD modules
  
1    Installation
     - Default installtion directory for Windows changed from
       'C:\MSC.Software\MSC_Nastran\2019' to
       'C:\Program Files\MSC.Software\MSC_Nastran\2019FP1
  
  
  
     Results HDF5 Database
     - Optional output of metadata such as username, operating system, software
       version, time & timezone, and IFPstar.
     - Composite ply stresses for random response analysis
     - HASHIN failure criteria for composites
     - RCROSS results
  
     New FORM Keyword in ASSIGN Statement
     - Support 32 bit output in OP2/OP4 for i8 mode
  
     Documentation
     The complete documentation set is provided in a separate installer and
     when installed is available at: MSC_DOC_DIR/doc/pdf_nastran directory.
     Where MSC_DOC_DIR is the directory where documentation was installed
     This help set has cross references between documents, links to how-to
     videos, and example files.
  
     Individual MSC Nastran documents are available for download from the
       Simcompanion Website at:
       http://simcompanion.mscsoftware.com/

 SEMG = STIFFNESS AND MASS MATRIX GENERATION STEP.
 SEMR = MASS MATRIX REDUCTION STEP (INCLUDES EIGENVALUE SOLUTION FOR MODES).

 SELG = LOAD MATRIX GENERATION STEP.
 SELR = LOAD MATRIX REDUCTION STEP. 
 MODES = T (TRUE) IF NORMAL MODES OR BUCKLING MODES CALCULATED.
 DYNRED = T (TRUE) MEANS GENERALIZED DYNAMIC AND/OR COMPONENT MODE REDUCTION PERFORMED.
 SOLLIN = T (TRUE) IF LINEAR SOLUTION EXISTS IN DATABASE.
 PVALID = P-DISTRIBUTION ID OF P-VALUE FOR P-ELEMENTS
 LOOPID = THE LAST LOOPID VALUE USED IN THE NONLINEAR ANALYSIS.  USEFUL FOR RESTARTS.
 SOLNL = T (TRUE) IF NONLINEAR SOLUTION EXISTS IN DATABASE.
 DESIGN CYCLE = THE LAST DESIGN CYCLE (ONLY VALID IN OPTIMIZATION).
